intro.text: A lighteyed scribe in Urithiru, a general's daughter who once courted Adolin.

items.text: Adolin considered her as a possible match for Kaladin. She and a friend visited Jez's Duty, a mostly darkeyed bar, on the day of Jor and Kryst's wedding party.

appearance.text: A young woman with a curvy figure and dark skin, who wears lip paint and a tight havah.

personality.text: Having scribed for her father in war meetings since she was fourteen, she loves to talk war strategy.
